overview: Hoppers can be placed pointing up. Aim at the bottom face of a block and the hopper you place lifts items instead of dropping them.
No new item and no recipe: it is the hopper you already have, aimed the way nobody tries.

2.0.2: Release notes rewritten to read plainly; nothing in play changes.
2.0.1: Breaking an upward hopper returns a hopper.
The readme now rides inside the jar.
2.0.0: An upward hopper holds a vanilla stack and answers a right-click the way one should.
With Village Quests installed, a farmer who has carried grain up a ladder asks for a lift.
1.0.0: Place a hopper against the bottom face of a block and it points up.
Break it and you get an ordinary hopper back.
